description: Despite Crew 16's own Sol 1 mold test confirming no harmful species (see FMARS-C16-2024-EVT024), three of the seven crew members were experiencing ongoing congestion by Sol 7, believed to be related to habitat humidity and residual mold exposure in hard-to-reach areas.
response: Additional, more extensive mold cleaning was carried out on the second and first floors.
lesson: A negative mold species test does not mean a mold-free environment — humidity control and thorough (not just visible-surface) cleaning matter independently of species toxicity. Track crew respiratory symptoms as a leading indicator and re-clean proactively rather than waiting for symptoms to worsen.
source_citation: SRC-flashline-crew-reports, FLASHLINE-16 DAILY REPORT 08-07-2024, lines 889-894. Sol: calculated from report date (08-07-2024) against Sol 1 = 02-07-2024. Confidence (B) rationale: daily-report narrative style.
